These five files were captured from the local Grok CLI workflow store on
2026-09-23 (one complete, one cancelled, three active). They preserve the full
`version` / `state` / `script_revision` envelope, all state keys, collection
shapes, statuses, counters and elapsed times. Run/agent identifiers and history
timestamps are anonymized; the completed report text is replaced with fixture
prose. No credential files were accessed.

The lifecycle tests clone the complete capture with distinct run ids/names to
exercise multiple cards. `workflow-stateless-phases.json` is an older field
transcription for parser/presentation tests, not a captured state file.
